answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor whose standing opens one marble petal of trust only after several already-established peers in SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single root, so its vouches fold back onto themselves like a closed lotus and never span distinct clusters; its clones stay solitary as a lone raven on a wire. Faking 100 heads costs 100 anchors plus 100 slow climbs, while an honest agent pays once.
